title: Pantry Metric4 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pantry:metric4
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for pantry metric4 (4) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate pantry metric4 (4) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It gently how your pantry metric4 (4) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
